source_text.body:
Run an agency's work through many Claude Code sessions
A small agency owner uses Claude Code for nearly everything, running many long-lived sessions across projects on the machines where the work lives.
·
Nov 16, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The poster says they run a small agency and use Claude Code for nearly everything: client projects with deployment pipelines and GitHub versioning across several servers, plus daily agency work like emails and to-dos. They keep many long-lived sessions tied to the machines and projects where the work lives, but by almost 200 sessions they were opening new chats just to ask Claude where old ones were.
How it went
The thread does not report a finished system or measured business result from the poster. The stated outcome is that they lost track of nearly 200 sessions and were looking for a better way to manage them.
Worth knowing
The main concrete catch is scale: they say they hit almost 200 sessions across project and admin work and could no longer keep track.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I run a small [type of agency] and want to manage my work through Claude Code sessions, one per project. Help me set up a folder structure for [list of 3 projects], with a short instruction file in each that describes the client, goals, tone, and rules about what you may and may not do. Then start a session for [project name] and complete this task: [describe task]. Pause before sending anything to a client or deleting any file.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xvyxav/how_do_you_manage_dozens_of_claude_code_sessions
